subject: distsql: support global index in `memIndexLookUpReader` (#52240)
summary: tablecodec `decodeHandleInIndexValue` now parses `IndexValueSegments` (v0/v1) and, when a PartitionID segment exists, returns a `kv.PartitionHandle` (pid + inner handle) instead of dropping the pid. This enables executor `memIndexLookUpReader` (via `DecodeIndexHandle` → handle list → `TableHandlesToKVRanges`) to generate record-key ranges with the correct partition table IDs for global index union-scan reads. Follow-up history on `upstream/master` includes additional global-index coverage (e.g. handle-in-key/non-unique cases), and no unfixed Blocker/High issue remains attributable to this commit.
